title: Two soldiers shot dead as gunmen fire on their motorcycle at Crossing Simuay, Sultan Kudarat
summary: Two men on a motorcycle chased and shot Pvt. Egie Boy Buta, 25, and Pvt. Jay-Ar Nacin Gregorio, 29, both of the Army's 40th Infantry Battalion, as they rode a motorcycle from North Cotabato towards Cotabato City, at Crossing Simuay Junction, Sultan Kudarat, Maguindanao del Norte, at about 2:50 p.m. on Tuesday, 24 November 2026. One was declared dead on arrival at the Cotabato Sanitarium General Hospital; the other died of his wounds hours later at the Cotabato Regional Medical Center. The gunmen fled on a Honda Click; police said two suspects were held after a pursuit. Two other soldiers were killed in a similar attack in the same municipality on 23 September.

sources.title: 2 soldiers killed in Maguindanao del Norte ambush

summary: Members of the Sampiano and Karim families exchanged gunfire in a remote part of Barangay Calilangan, Balabagan, Lanao del Sur, shortly after 1 p.m. on Sunday, 22 November 2026. Adnan Lim Maute, alias Abdul, 26, of Barangay Poblacion and a member of the Sampiano clan, was hit in the head by a bullet or shrapnel and taken to the Dr. Serapio Montaner Jr. Al-Haj Memorial Hospital in Malabang. Police said the Karim side allegedly fired first; the 2nd Provincial Mobile Force Company was sent in to keep the feud from spreading.
